model_boundary.name: Semantic Fact IR
model_boundary.yul_input: completed S-SEIR high-level semantic overlays only; control summaries provide Fact CFG structure but never synthetic semantic definitions
model_boundary.recovery_boundary: Yul recovery CFG, MemorySSA, SinkResolver and low-level effects remain upstream evidence and are not Fact IR inputs
model_boundary.ordering: Fact CFG partial order plus block-local semantic order
model_boundary.path_policy: canonical semantic nodes are not path-cloned; path witnesses are derived on demand
model_boundary.program_links: cross-function links reference final function FactCFGs and semantic nodes; they never inline or duplicate callee semantics

model_boundary.ordering: function-level CFG partial order plus block-local operation order
model_boundary.solidity: SolidityAtomicOperationExtractor produces sol_atom records; SoliditySemanticLifter only projects each atom to the common schema.
model_boundary.yul: S-SEIR alone analyzes Yul; YulSemanticLifter only projects completed S-SEIR results to the common schema.
model_boundary.bridge: SemanticFactBridge restores function-level CFG order while preserving S-SEIR path instances and path-compatible control predecessors after both sources already share one schema.
